clues.text: King David told Nathan the prophet he lived in a house of this while the ark of God stayed in a tent.
Exiles back from captivity paid men of Sidon and Tyre to bring logs of this from Lebanon to Joppa by sea.
Solomon paneled the temple's inner walls with this wood, carved with gourds and flowers, so no stone could be seen.
In King Solomon's day, Jerusalem had this as plentiful as sycamore trees in the foothills.
To cleanse someone healed of a skin disease, the priest used two birds, scarlet yarn, hyssop, and this wood.
Hiram king of Tyre sent David logs of this wood, along with carpenters and stonemasons, to build his palace.
King Jehoash of Israel told of a thistle in Lebanon asking this tree to give its daughter in marriage.
